purpose: Determine whether sampled SEC CT ORDER documents contain deterministic, public temporal state anchors suitable for later lineage reconstruction.
sample_rule: reuse the source-gate population rule: first/median/last recovered CT ORDER accession per calendar year, sorted by filing date then accession
document_source: exact SEC archive CT ORDER document declared by the complete submission text
extraction_tool: pdftotext -layout; record executable version in receipt
cheap_falsifiers: sample CT ORDER PDFs are not deterministically retrievable from SEC archives
text extraction fails for a material fraction of the fixed sample
temporal-state terms do not co-occur with explicit dates often enough to support deterministic document-state reconstruction
document text is too unstable across the pre/post-2019 regime split for a common extraction contract
